scope.summary: OPTIONAL adapter lane framework: expose generative/ML filters as StudioLiveFilter entries whose filter_kind binds to a StudioModelAdapter (14.23); when no adapter is configured the effect surfaces a determinate EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE result (never a silent no-op); a local downloadable model and a cloud provider are the SAME effect kind with different adapter bindings. Adapter output MUST land as a non-destructive stack entry or a new masked layer (current / new / masked / new document) selectable by operator/model, never overwriting source; provider calls obey the headless/quiet law (bounded, observable, attributable, no foreground popup). Includes the ML Filter lane workspace host. MARK optional; not required for Studio parity.
acceptance_criteria: OPTIONAL adapter lane: StudioModelAdapter binding, EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE, local==cloud effect kind, non-destructive output landing, headless/quiet; ML Filter lane workspace host
proof_targets: adapter-unavailable determinate state + non-destructive landing + quiet test
expected_tests: test: no adapter configured -> EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE (not silent no-op); same effect_kind binds local vs cloud adapter
test: adapter output lands as non-destructive entry / new masked layer (never overwrites source); quiet (no popup, bounded, attributable)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Generative filters silently no-op or overwrite source; optional lane unsafe.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
